# Serhii Lisovyk Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Serhii Lisovyk, a frontend developer focused on Next.js, React, TypeScript, product UI, performance, and maintainable interface architecture.

This site presents Serhii Lisovyk's frontend skills, commercial experience, selected projects, contact links, and multilingual portfolio pages. The canonical public site is `https://portfolio-sigma-two-y3hyu3g61d.vercel.app`.

## Primary Pages

- [English portfolio](https://portfolio-sigma-two-y3hyu3g61d.vercel.app/en): Main English version of the portfolio.
- [Ukrainian portfolio](https://portfolio-sigma-two-y3hyu3g61d.vercel.app/uk): Ukrainian localized version.
- [Russian portfolio](https://portfolio-sigma-two-y3hyu3g61d.vercel.app/ru): Russian localized version.
- [Sitemap](https://portfolio-sigma-two-y3hyu3g61d.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): Indexable localized URLs.

## Project Highlights

- [Quotes demo](https://quotes-xi-five.vercel.app): Full-stack PERN quotes application with search, tags, CRUD flows, and REST API integration.
- [Quotes repository](https://github.com/serlisovyk/Quotes): Source code for the Quotes project.
- [Pizza demo](https://pizza-client-red.vercel.app/): Full-stack MERN pizza store with catalog filtering, sorting, pagination, and cart state.
- [Pizza repository](https://github.com/serlisovyk/Pizza): Source code for the Pizza project.

## Profiles

- [GitHub](https://github.com/serlisovyk): Source code and public repositories.
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/serhii-lisovyk-b43a4b29b/): Professional profile, certificates, and recommendations.
- [Telegram](https://t.me/serlisovyk): Direct contact channel.

## Technical Context

- Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, next-intl, next-themes, GSAP.
- Languages: English, Ukrainian, Russian.
- Site features: responsive layout, dark/light theme, localized metadata, Open Graph metadata, sitemap, robots.txt, JSON-LD, and optimized images via `next/image`.
